relationships.subject: CFA
relationships.evidence_quote: These structural changes in the C afferents and their pre- and postsynaptic elements in the MDH following inflammation may provide the morphological basis for the development and long-term maintenance of craniofacial inflammatory pain.

key_findings: CFA increased ultrastructural synaptic strength parameters of CGRP+ and IB4+ boutons in the MDH at 4 days.
Axoaxonic synapses on IB4+ boutons and GAD65/67+ boutons decreased at 4 days and recovered by 21 days.
